period: 1955–1968; emphasis on final economic and antiwar programme

axisReviews.evidence: Voting rights and accountable democratic participation were central to his civil-rights work.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Civil disobedience challenged unjust laws but did not propose unelected replacement of the electorate.

axisReviews.evidence: Peaceful disruptive protest, freedom of expression and resistance to abusive policing favour liberty.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He called for nonviolent discipline and protection against violence; civil freedom is not approval of every risky drug or firearm choice.

axisReviews.evidence: Equal citizenship and interracial cooperation support an inclusive national community.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His integrationist vision shares civic institutions and does not privilege separate identity over every common duty.

axisReviews.evidence: Universal human dignity and solidarity with poor communities support generous migration and humanitarian protection.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He left no detailed national immigration programme; visa mechanisms are historical educated assumptions, not policies attributed directly.

axisReviews.evidence: Nonviolence and the final antiwar programme reject military solutions and favour negotiated peace.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His views developed from earlier self-defence to deeper pacifism; the later programme receives greater weight.

axisReviews.evidence: International human solidarity and criticism of economic nationalism favour shared global responsibility.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Opposition to the Vietnam War is not alone proof of every supranational legal institution; institutional details remain inferred.

axisReviews.evidence: Public action for jobs, housing and social security expands provision beyond private profit priorities.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: King criticised capitalism but did not offer a detailed plan to nationalise every industry; a guaranteed income need not imply government ownership.

axisReviews.evidence: Global solidarity and concern for workers qualify economic competition without demanding national economic isolation.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No detailed tariff schedule was found; trade safeguards are contextual extensions of social justice rather than a supplied protectionist doctrine.

axisReviews.evidence: Guaranteed income, jobs and anti-poverty public investment require substantial economic intervention.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Human dignity and democratic agency qualify compulsory command of all normal production; socialist sympathy is not Soviet planning.

axisReviews.evidence: His final programme advocates guaranteed income and material economic security as necessary for full citizenship.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Compensated land redistribution is a weaker extension than income support; the profile does not invent a detailed tax code.

axisReviews.evidence: Religious moral advocacy accompanies plural constitutional government and equal citizenship.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He was a minister, but public faith does not establish support for a state church, religious courts or clergy approval of legislation.

axisReviews.evidence: Anti-discrimination and radical change in racial institutions coexist with some conventional sexual and family expectations.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: His expectations of Coretta and period-specific comments qualify retrospective assignment of a complete modern progressive programme.

axisReviews.evidence: Concern for the social costs of scientific advance favours human welfare and scrutiny alongside useful development.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Support for jobs and housing is developmental; caution on implants and embryo enhancement is a historical analogy, not a recorded proposal.

axisReviews.evidence: Federal civil-rights enforcement is required against discriminatory local institutions.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Community organisation and local participation remain important; national rights do not require a single national police service.

axisReviews.evidence: His social-gospel account links deprivation, humiliation and learned prejudice to behaviour and social outcomes.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Belief in universal human nature and moral capacity qualifies pure blank-slate claims; precise stress and temperament comparisons remain estimates.
